captured_actor.description:
A warm smile spreads over an old face freckled by time and a million crumbs of salt. He shrinks under a hunched back and drums the ground beneath him with a short and barb-crowned tail. A second pair of arms rise over the slump of his shoulders, where hands meet and fingers lace to form another face, this one vacant and prehistoric, no mouth and eyes desert-white.
{{C|-----}}
Loved by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}}.

Hated by {{C|the villagers of Kiggashur}} for questioning the origins of the moon.

Disliked by {{C|goatfolk}} for casting doubt on their beliefs.

Admired by {{C|the Daughters of Exile}} for respecting the sanctity of a burial site.

equipped.description:
Wool was dyed in a bath of dreadroot and iron salt, and then woven to warm broad shoulders.

{{K|Weight: 1 lbs.}}

Two almonds of glass sit in wireframe cups and resharpen the world's edges.

{{K|Weight: 1 lbs.}}

A pair of strapped shoes are cracked on the soles in sinelike patterns of gravel walking.

{{K|Weight: 1 lbs.}}

donor_limits: Core human presentation retained. No close installed whole-body equivalent for a four-armed elder whose joined hands form a second face; use exact Qud anatomy and authored separate additions.

anatomy.baseline: Unchanged selected unmutated older-human body/head; its two arms/hands and paired feet remain intact.
anatomy.additions: Exactly one extra pair of arms, joined/interlaced hands forming a mouthless face with desert-white eyes; one short barb-crowned tail. No extra legs or head graft.
anatomy.native_semantics: Hands-Face211 is a Face variant under Hands210, not an additional Head node. Preserve all exact part IDs/parents/managers/lateralities. Raised-pair geometry is a description-based neutral visual pose, not proof of a bone/part-to-limb mapping.
anatomy.attachment_uncertainty: Captured Walking Stick541 occupies changed Hand201/6. This unarmed anatomy proposal does not establish how that equipped hand and the hands-face pose coexist. Resolve exact attachment/pose in NPC-ELDERBOB authoring; do not silently rename it to another hand.

frame.method: Integer transparent top padding only. Original body/head pixels remain unchanged at y+240. Preserve world position/scale by extending render height and center consistently; equipment inherits the same pad.

authored_interpretation: Raised-arm curves, exact interlacing pattern, barb count and unseen tail curvature are authored. Keep intrinsic anatomy and count source-bound. Tail is posterior; back of hands has no second set of eyes.
workflow: Source-bound separate mutation art over existing unmutated body. No race-body replacement, renderer/framework, profession pose, personal cosmetics or game launch.
native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation and integrated anatomy/equipment/visibility/hurt/look/save review.
